dataset.name: Population-based breast cancer (SCAN-B)
dataset.description: Independent population-based primary breast cancer RNA-seq cohort with GEO-published gene expression and overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Prospective SCAN-B validation cohort of nonmetastatic primary unilateral breast cancers from Sweden. Technical replicates are excluded and the cohort remains separate from TCGA-BRCA.
dataset.publication_citation: Brueffer et al. JCO Precision Oncology 2018

metadata.redistribution_note: The processed public matrix is analyzable in TCGA-TRACE, but matrix downloads remain disabled because GEO access does not by itself establish redistribution rights.
metadata.curation_note: Only titles matching F followed by an integer are retained; the 136 technical-replicate columns are excluded. GEO states that gene-level FPKM was collapsed to unique symbols, offset by 0.1 and log2-transformed.

expression.label: log2(FPKM + 0.1)
expression.mapping_source: GEO GSE96058 supplied unique gene symbols
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The publication states that transcript FPKM values were collapsed to 30,865 exact gene-symbol strings. Two capitalization-only symbol pairs remain in the file; all rows for those ambiguous canonical symbols are excluded rather than merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: Values are retained exactly at the GEO-supplied log2(FPKM + 0.1) scale; TCGA-TRACE applies no second transformation.
